title: ep1.0_research_preview.md
logline: A calm "nonprofit guy" presses a button marked research preview and launches the fastest-growing product anyone has seen. Every government asks him to regulate himself, and all year a Friday-noon board sync waits in his calendar.

beats.caption: APEC stage. The wide drifts to the window: a banquet ovation, one lit window across the bay. Then a hailstone.
cues: sfx: the hailstone lands in his glass; the moderator's sloshes, his stays flat

beats.caption: Freeze. Only Mas and his phone stay in colour: an invite, four unnamed circles. He taps Accept, no look.
cues: music: one dry piano F4, left to ring

beats.caption: The Orb's toast: rewinding… The room scrubs backward to 1993: a lone dialog, OK, and Cancel greyed out.
INTRO · the 30 s title sequence (see the intro animatic), then the file card and the disclaimer.
onscreen: A parody. Events dramatized; scenes invented. Names changed to protect the valuations.

beats.caption: Launch night. And if it breaks? Works? Alyi, a reflection in the glass: wakes up? Click. The bubble speaks.

onscreen: POST: "…just crossed 1 million users; it's been 5 days since launch"
